scope: SOURCE_ONLY: independent direct-source review, stdlib AST/compile and field-consistency inspections only.
routing_attestation: The reviewer task is observable; actual serving-model and effort metadata are not exposed. Requested routing is not treated as actual attestation.

blocking_findings.title: A raised transport call leaves no structured attempt receipt.
blocking_findings.finding: Each helper calls subprocess.run with timeout=180 before writing its transport_actual JSON. The existing stdout/stderr files survive, but TimeoutExpired or another raised run call skips the receipt entirely. Ordinary nonzero exit handling is correct: its actual returncode is recorded before check_returncode raises. This is a static failure-recording defect under the explicit complete-failure-capture requirement; no timeout of these unexecuted helpers is claimed.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Write an ATTEMPT_STARTED receipt containing start time and the exact stdout/stderr paths before subprocess.run. Do not invent an exit code; leave it absent or explicitly unknown. After run returns, overwrite that receipt with the actual completed returncode. No additional try/except, fallback, automatic retry or restart is needed.
blocking_findings.rationale: The explicit review contract requires complete transport failure evidence. A finite timeout is already present in all three sources, so the missing-record branch follows directly from the current code.

blocking_findings.title: The short MSVR310 completion node reads the longer RGBNT100 job early.
blocking_findings.finding: The due time is selected by --dataset, but the embedded observer enumerates every child launch/PID and every training directory. At the MSVR310 node it reads RGBNT100 process liveness and epochs.csv before the RGBNT100 completion node. The configured historical estimates are 1895.278 seconds for MSVR310 and 11622.726 seconds for RGBNT100 after their respective starts: about 9727 seconds (2.70 hours) apart for concurrent starts. This defeats the requested per-component observation cadence.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Restrict child launch/PID inspection and training progress reads to the selected dataset prefix or exact selected training directory. The original controller liveness/result and selected component receipt may still be read once. Do not change the controller, training schedule or other component deadline.
blocking_findings.rationale: The source contains two concurrently admitted cases with materially different explicitly stored completion estimates. The unfiltered loops deterministically inspect both cases when the earlier selected due time arrives; this is not a hypothetical race.

The original request, addendum and 18 listed public source/input files are preserved under this trace. No implementation or F audit input was modified.

checks.conclusion: The tar includes the four finite candidate/controller sources plus the intake and final F audit JSON at their project-relative names. They do not overlap the inherited 376 source seals. The remote launch checks the exact member set, limits resolved destinations to the project, verifies transferred bytes and inherited seals, then starts the original controller once. checks.check: Finite cases and sequential phase barriers
checks.conclusion: R3 contains only RGBNT100/demo/head32 on physicalGPU2 and MSVR310/demo_shared/head16 on physicalGPU3, seed42. Each neural phase has two workers and one case per card. Both head8 parities complete successfully before native; both three-update natives complete successfully before formal training. Aggregate parity64 and native6 fields are correct. The existing execute helper enforces GPU2/3 and records actual child exit codes without retry.

The native observer consumes the real R3 native_acceptance status, actual_updates, parity_forward_record_executions, strict_reload and all_active_gradients fields. Child launch/exit field names match gpu_thermal_execute. Smoke arguments, steps/attempts/skips, parameter totals and descriptor_shape match the inherited producer and the two CASES. Native-derived formal starts and completion estimates match the completion observer input fields. The selected component filename matches R3; observation alone does not attest completion.

The inherited runner performs all50 epochs, complete official train/QG, positive successful optimizer updates and earliest maximum-mAP checkpoint selection with all six metrics from the selected checkpoint. R3 selects the existing5120D auditor for RGBNT100 and5632D auditor for MSVR310, requires full coverage, actual child exit0 and CPU GT audit PASS, and retains selected best/raw artifacts. No RGBNT201, missing-modality evaluation, seed sweep or new model module is introduced.

Eleven listed public Python sources, eight private helper sources and all four embedded remote snippets parsed and compiled with stdlib only. Seven listed JSON sources were parsed. All inspected local receipt/proof suffixes and the embedded remote owner suffix are real newlines. Compile placeholders were used only for a future audit manifest, process owner and selected observer path; no target code was executed.

The native helper sleeps to its original240-second node and performs one observation. Completion helper choices are limited to the two datasets and consume native-derived due times. Neither observer launches a neural job or queries GPU/temperature/power. The deployer reads only selectedGPU2/3 memory/utilization/process occupancy before launch and checks protected weights. Runtime resource availability, parity, native updates and completion were not observed by this review.

runtime_evidence: NOT_RUN. SOURCE_ONLY FAIL does not authorize deployment; no resource, parity, native, neural or new-method-gain claim is made.
final_conclusion: Two demonstrated helper defects remain: missing pre-call transport attempt evidence and unfiltered early inspection of the other component. The reviewed core admission order, schemas, phase barriers, transfer paths and serialization are otherwise correct. Apply only the two scoped fixes and request same-reviewer source followup.
